faqs.q: Can we host the ceremony and reception in the same room?
faqs.a: Yes. We flip the room from ceremony to reception during cocktail hour — no second venue, no transportation.
Yes. Every plated and buffet wedding package includes a complimentary menu tasting for the couple.

faqs.q: Do you offer a guest-room block?
faqs.a: Yes. Every wedding qualifies for a discounted block of suites at preferred rates for out-of-town family and friends.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faqs.a: Yes — and this is one of our biggest differences from most hotel venues. Many ballrooms lock you into their kitchen. We don't. You have two strong options: (1) use our in-house catering — plated dinners, stations, family-style, the full menu, prepared by Chef Ken and his team; or (2) bring your own caterer (cultural, family, kosher, halal, ethnic specialties — whoever you want) with a modest catering fee. Either way you get tables, chairs, linens, china, glassware, silverware, and full kitchen access.
Florists, photographers, videographers, DJs, bands, and officiants are all welcome — bring whoever you love working with. Outside cake is welcome with a cutting and plating fee.
Tables, chairs, linens, china, glassware, and silverware are included. We'll set up your centerpieces, place cards, and signage at no extra charge — just drop them off ahead of time.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.a: Most weddings book 9–18 months ahead. Saturday evenings during peak season (May–October) book first.
